notes: No polygon. Southern frontier at Semna (GHA II pp.240, 255, 258). Northern/Levant limits: no cited source; left open.

properties.label_detail_en: "The southern boundary of the Egyptian Middle Kingdom was unquestionably fixed at Semna by Senusret III" (GHA II p.258; also pp.240, 255, boundary stele). Start -1870 is a display value for Senusret III's reign (not given as a year in GHA). Not a drawn line.
properties.label_detail_ar: «ثُبّت الحد الجنوبي للدولة الوسطى عند سمنة على يد سنوسرت الثالث» (تاريخ أفريقيا العام II ص258، 240، 255). [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]

properties.label_detail_en: Middle Kingdom fortress; Lower Nubia occupied under the 12th dynasty (−1991 to −1786) "as far as Semna" (GHA II pp.255, 258). Not a border.
